lines.japanese: 「そういえば針生さんって進学希望なのかな」
lines.english: “Come to think of it, does Hariu plan to go to university?”
“What? Why do you ask about Hariu?”

lines.japanese: 「なんでって聞かれると困るんだけど……」
lines.english: “That’s hard to answer when you put it like that...”

lines.japanese: 僕は首を捻ってみせた。そういえば明日から野鳥の観察をするって言ってたけど、針生さんは本当に離島まで行くのかなあ。
lines.english: I tilted my head. He had said he would begin observing wild birds tomorrow, but was Hariu truly going all the way to a remote island?

lines.japanese: 「ええと、知り合いが居ないよりは、居てくれた方が心強いじゃない」
lines.english: “Well, having somebody you know there is more reassuring than knowing nobody.”

lines.japanese: 「ん、ん、ますます分からなくなった。羽田君と先輩ってそんなに仲いいの？」
lines.english: “Mm... now I understand even less. Are you and Hariu really that close?”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、ほとんど話したことはないよ」
「一応クラスメイトだから、知り合いには入るんじゃないかな……」
lines.english: “We are classmates, at least. I think that makes us acquaintances...”

lines.japanese: 「でも、私はクラスメイトでも、知り合いに入らないひとっているよ」
lines.english: “There are classmates I wouldn’t count as people I know.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、まあ……そうかもしれないけど……」
「ほら、針生さんって話すと面白いし」
lines.english: “But Hariu is interesting when you talk to him.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんが妙に僕のことを感心した目で見てる。なんでだろう、渡来さんも針生さんと話すのが好きなのかな。
lines.english: Watarai regarded me as if she were oddly impressed. Why? Perhaps she too enjoyed speaking with Hariu.

lines.japanese: やっぱり行けばよかったかなあ、離島。
lines.english: Maybe I should have gone to the remote island after all.
